TEXT.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

S.FORM: Ka tou wæ'i k'anna ni-iroua ta ti Joannes ka Tama Eulough matta-sasou tou pæulæpæulægh ki Judea,
S.TRANSL: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,
那時，有施洗的約翰出來，在猶太的曠野傳道，說：

S.FORM: Koun; Si lalâ [pa-salikough-â ki vana-oumi ki rygh] ka ni-moutouk ta pei-sasou-an ki tounoun ki vulluvullum.
S.TRANSL: And saying, Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
「天國近了，你們應當悔改！」

S.FORM: Ka teni ta ti atta ka ni-pasousou-en ki Mattæi-tan ka ti Esajas, koun; Yngau ki Makou-langægh tou pæulæpæulægh, Si-d'a d'arang-â paka-parilpil ki darang ki MEIRANG, pei-tiktik-au ta 'ouhkakoun tyn.
S.TRANSL: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
這人就是先知以賽亞所說的。他說：「在曠野有人聲喊着說： 預備主的道， 修直他的路！」

S.FORM: Teni ta ti Joannes ka ni-akou-mea ki pam-mammi-en tyn ka na rivyng ki louang, ka akoutououk [ka kemel k'ma-qua] ki æ'it appa ka na koura'æu, ka ni-maid ki valut tyn, ka kan-nin tyn idahi na houwallau-appa ta anna.
S.TRANSL: And the same John had his raiment of camel's hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his meat was locusts and wild honey.
這約翰身穿駱駝毛的衣服，腰束皮帶，吃的是蝗蟲、野蜜。

S.FORM: Tou kidi kanna ni't pæpænæh mou-qua tyni-æn ta Jerusalem, ymdei-au-appa ta Judea, ymmud-appa ki sat ka da poudapan ka tou hivat ki Jordaan.
S.TRANSL: Then went out to him Jerusalem, and all Judaea, and all the region round about Jordan,
那時，耶路撒冷和猶太全地，並約旦河一帶地方的人，都出去到約翰那裏，

S.FORM: Ka ni-'æuloug han tyn ta neni tou' Jordaan, tou pou-pæpænæg-hen ki varau nein-ra.
S.TRANSL: And were baptized of him in Jordan, confessing their sins.
承認他們的罪，在約旦河裏受他的洗。

S.FORM: Teni ra, dou 'ararau-en tyn ta hmabatoung ki Fariseen ki Sadduceen tou 'æuloug-han tyn, ni-k'ma neini-æn; Na kakubkub ki 't poung, ti mang ta ni-madouk ymoumi-an pa-ilpout ki nḡale ka rou roumang-ah.
S.TRANSL: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
約翰看見許多法利賽人和撒都該人也來受洗，就對他們說：「毒蛇的種類！誰指示你們逃避將來的忿怒呢？

S.FORM: Anna ta makka-voua ki voua ka na ka'ang-al-len pasalikough-noumi si-lala.
S.TRANSL: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:
你們要結出果子來，與悔改的心相稱。

S.FORM: Ynna pou-kidi ymoumi-an pæg-dimdim pæg-mado pæg-k'ma-hynna; Akou na Rarama'n kame ti Abraham-an. Ka pasousou-en-'au-kamou ra, ka pa-ilpough ta Alid pæ æhpit ki vahto k'anna ki alalak ti Abraham-an.
S.TRANSL: And think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
不要自己心裏說：『有亞伯拉罕為我們的祖宗。』我告訴你們，上帝能從這些石頭中給亞伯拉罕興起子孫來。

S.FORM: Hnyn-da ni-atta-quan ta vouthau tou patar ki pærænnærænnæh: ymmid ki pærænnæh ka assi makka-voua ki voua ka mariang, t'aghta-aul-ato maryng tou apoei.
S.TRANSL: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
現在斧子已經放在樹根上，凡不結好果子的樹就砍下來，丟在火裏。

S.FORM: Ti jau ta mæulough ymoumi-æn ki raloum tou si-lala-an; Ra teni ka si-æuh jauwan mou-qua ta marareih maligh iau-an, ka assi koh tou keirang-an mei-qua ki tatapil tyn-da; teni ta mmæuloug-ah ymoumi-æn ki I-oep-an ka Dlligh Matiktik, ki apoei-appa-ra.
S.TRANSL: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance. but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire:
我是用水給你們施洗，叫你們悔改。但那在我以後來的，能力比我更大，我就是給他提鞋也不配。他要用聖靈與火給你們施洗。

S.FORM: Ka varakou tyn pei-qua'n ki rima tyn, ka paka-kouptigh-ah ki dæddæddæ-en-tyn, ka palilid-dauh tyn ta yroung tou kouvau: Houdægh-da pa-'yllamag-euh tyn tou apoei ka assi hmahei pa-'iougp-pun.
S.TRANSL: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.
他手裏拿着簸箕，要揚淨他的場，把麥子收在倉裏，把糠用不滅的火燒盡了。」

S.FORM: Tou kidi kanna ni-irouä ta ti Jesus makka-Galilæa tou Jordaan ti Joannes-an, alei ka pa-'æuloug-eih tyn tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.
當下，耶穌從加利利來到約旦河，見了約翰，要受他的洗。

S.FORM: Ra ni-ouhang mavagh ta ti Joannes tyni-æn, koun-hia; Kidi-atou-mau ka 'æulough-ei-mhou-koh, ka iroua kow mou-qua jau-an?
S.TRANSL: But John forbad him, saying, I have need to be baptized of thee, and comest thou to me?
約翰想要攔住他，說：「我當受你的洗，你反倒上我這裏來嗎？」

S.FORM: Ra ni-mattæ'i-vli ta ti Jesus k'ma tyni-æn; Mous-sâ hnyn, ka kidi-ato ymit-'æn ta k'ma-hynna ka pam't-au-mytta ta katiktik-an ka ymmud. Anna ta ni-mous-ato tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: And Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffered him.
耶穌回答說：「你暫且許我，因為我們理當這樣盡諸般的義。」於是約翰許了他。

S.FORM: Irou ka ni-'æuloug-han ta ti Jesus, madys ni-mah-dakkin ka ni-makka-raloum. Ka k'yttey ni-luhtouaf tyni-æn ta vulluvullum, ka ni-k'ytt'-an tyn ta I-oep-an ki Alid, ka ni-mou-rarim mama ki padæugh 't-hgalap tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:
耶穌受了洗，隨即從水裏上來。天忽然為他開了，他就看見上帝的靈彷彿鴿子降下，落在他身上。

S.FORM: Ka k'ytt'-ei ta yngau ka ni-makka-tounnoun ki vullu-vullum, ka ni-k'ma; Ti atta ta alak-au ka kavæango-en ka kamau-'nau ta teni.
S.TRANSL: And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
從天上有聲音說：「這是我的愛子，我所喜悅的。」
